assumptions.statement: Official polygons for the three-level scope are not yet published; the submitted site boundary is a provisional_constraint inferred from the announcement text, with official_boundary=false.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines and cross-sections are missing.

assumptions.statement: Current land-parcel boundaries and ownership status are missing.

assumptions.statement: Current building footprints, heights, uses and construction dates are missing.

assumptions.statement: Municipal pipelines, fire safety, flood control and sponge-city conditions are missing.

Talent-life services and public facilities are expressed as a service system and pending facility checklist, not verified capacities.
